title: The Lacerta files: Swedish documents about reptilians

tellings.quote: amazing piece on the LERA files, these, you know, documents uh from from Sweden about these like reptilians or whatever.

plain: There is a set of documents from Sweden, known as the Lacerta files, about reptilians, reptile-like beings said to live hidden among humans. Jesse Michels mentions them only in passing to his guest Chris Ramsay, praising what he calls Ramsay's "amazing piece" on the files, and says nothing more of what they contain.
